reviews.title: Ignores notification settings
reviews.text: Sends me promotional offer notifications despite this being explicitly turned off in the settings.

reviews.title: Unwanted promotional messages
reviews.text: I have selected “no” to receiving promotional messages (ads), and yes I’m getting promotional push notifications. Cardinal sin for any app.

reviews.text: نحتاج تحديث للجهزه الراوتر و تطوير اكثر منيات في البرنامج

reviews.title: It works-ish
reviews.text: Doesn’t show most connected devices, randomly says one device is offline when it’s not, and nothing can be done about it. The device is clearly working.

reviews.title: Never ending login
reviews.text: Not really sure what is going on with this app, but if I login on my desktop, I have no issues but as soon as I try to login using the same username and password on this app, I get that the username or password is invalid. I also set up Face ID and that does not work either. I can’t be the only one who is having this issue. The only way that I can get the app to work is by changing my password every time I want to use it, which is completely stupid.

reviews.title: Good Wi-Fi but badly let down by app especially for Voice Over users.
reviews.text:
I must firstly say that the Wi-Fi generally works well.  We have had some drop outs and unexplained loss of connection however generally Stable.  I regret that as a Voice Over user however the set up was challenging at best.  The app does not respond to taps.  Items are spoken in a very random order which I am told does not reflect what is seen.  I was able to set up and run the network however recent update has made the app totally unusable and effectively locked me out of my Wi-FI.  

Currently therefore I cannot recommend this system to anyone who needs to use Voice over which is a great pity as the hardware is good and reasonably priced.  I hope that TP LInk will review the accessibility of the app and resolve the numerous issues which were tolerable but are now unacceptable.

reviews.title: Moves functions that the devices were sold with behind a subscription. Shady.
reviews.text:
Update: TPLINK’s decision to take away most of the parental control functionality the devices came with and lock it behind a subscription verges on criminal.

Removing functionality that was paid for to force people to pay again for what they ALREADY bought is  a despicable business practise - shame on this company. They used to be good. Now I wouldn’t recommend.

My old, glowing 5* review for the older version before TPLink’s greed set in is below:

This worked really well to setup a 3 node Deco M9 (replacing the rubbish BT HomeHub and WholeHome mesh we previously used). It’s great as far as it goes - but it doesn’t go far enough.

The parental controls are good, as is the reporting & monitoring.

It’s a million times better than BT’s half hearted unreliable effort. However...

The SmartHome support is just not good enough. 

For iOS14, it needs a widget (for network status & smart home control).

TPLink removed IFTTT support this earlier this year - fair enough if they were going to actually replace it with something - the built in automation is just not good enough - it lacks any remote trigger facility & can’t do Geofencing. Needs an urgent update to either restore IFTTT or add an equivalent SmartHome control system, or folks won’t be able to do anything really useful with the Zigbee radios.

reviews.title: Poorly designed AI slop app
reviews.text: You can tell this was built using AI, the design is tasteless, buttons don’t work correctly, have to jump through a million pages to get to a setting, some settings are reachable from different locations, some buttons don’t work, it’s very glitchy, had to quit the app multiple times after pressing some buttons. I wish they’d put more time into it like the Tapo app, which is a very well made app. I paid a lot of money for the wifi mesh system, you’d think they would spend time making an app that works well and reflects the price tag.

reviews.title: Great devices, rubbish app, still
reviews.text: While the deco’s themselves are fantastic and give drop-out free WiFi around my home, the app is dire. It’s touted as great for family device time routines but the app is sluggish and unreliable. It takes multiple attempts to change a routine. You need to hit block several times to block a profile and even then it may not actually be blocked: app says profile blocked. Kill app, restart, refresh and lo-and-behold, profile is actually online. Try again to block. Every update that improves performance I’m in hope the app becomes reliable, but then it’s the same as before. If the devices were just as bad I’d have asked for a refund years ago.

reviews.title: Advanced features just don’t work
reviews.text: This review is for the App, rather than the hardware. Running a mesh of three X50s (one as the main unit) and two X55s. Have been trying for weeks to configure port forwarding and address reservation for a number of connected clients. Constantly getting “Failed to save the information. please try again later.” Get same message frequently when trying to change a devices name. Have tried exchanging the main unit for another,  and other suggestions from support sites. All to no avail. Seriously thinking of having to swap out the whole system for another which would be a shame, as hardware works well, but app is hopeless at managing devices. Please sort out the App to allow these simple tasks to be achieved.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
If you need to do anything more than plug in your switch and connect to it, you're screwed with this device ecosystem and software. Get an Archer and use the inferior EasyMesh instead if you know what a MAC address is.

A) you can only access your device's setup on a mobile app
B) you must create an account and give TP-Link data
C) you have to find the telemetry opt-out manually or your internet usage could be mined and sold
D) settings options are super basic and limited
E) setting up port forwarding on a phone is annoying enough, but you have to clear and reset server IP reservations each time you add a new NAT rule because you must make a new reservation when making a rule even if the reservation already exists, but you can't over write an existing reservation.
F) if you manually set your IP on your NIC, Deco will make a DHCP reservation for it on top of that. But if you selected an IP outside of the DHCP server range you'll get errors. Who makes a reservation inside a DHCP range?!
G) it keeps advertising security subscriptions at me
H) the app abuses the phone notifications by sending "reports" that only tell you you haven't bought their security subscription yet with some scare tactics

Otherwise, the app mostly works and I was able to connect devices pretty quickly. Any advanced setting is just so annoying.

reviews.title: Stupid App?!
reviews.text:
Been using this product now for more than 3 years. Always behaved well until yesterday when I noticed the LEDs on ALL 6 of my decos were red.  Not uncommon in this area. Lots of surges, lots of internet outages. Went to the app, it treated me like a brand new user. Wanted an account ID & password, wanted me to help it find my decos!  Ahh, probably an old app version that didn’t update properly, right?  Uninstalled existing app and downloaded version 3.0 from Apple. Installed nicely. Now it permits Face ID. Great!  New app logged me in seamlessly, found all my decos, no problem. BUT, now 3 are still red. Must be a setting issue with my mixed model decos, so started trying to identify the problem. NEW problem found now - app v. 3.0 will not permit ANY save to setting changes.  There’s NO documentation for this problem!  I can’t do anything except kill power to all and then restore them one at a time throughout the property.  Doubtful that action will enable the app to save settings.  
Just noticed this morning, 5 of 6 are red again.  Only one working is the wired main. Rest are down. How is this considered a stable platform??

reviews.title: Parental controls don’t work including paid version
reviews.text: I do not know what deco did to this app, but every since they changed the parental controls to a paid version, it no longer works. I cannot add profiles. I cannot block devices or set time limits. I thought maybe the issue was the free version so I subscribed to the paid version and it is just as glitchy. I spent HOURS on the phone with their tech support deleting my entire network and then having to reinstall every single Tp link device separately including 5 decos and numerous cameras. The app worked for less than 24 hours after the reinstall and now it is back to not working. A simple search online shows NUMEROUS people having the same issue, yet the company has done NOTHING to fix it. Seriously disappointed since I have invested so much into devices that I thought came from a reliable company.

reviews.title: Why subscribe?
reviews.text: I bought the Deco mesh routers, I installed the app, connected the Ethernet and WiFi, and now… I’m supposed to pay Deco money so that I can use my own equipment? For example just to turn off the internet or block websites? To do these you need to pay for a subscription. Even just to access your own network history data you have to pay. Please, just include these in the normal app, not behind a pay wall. If you do that then we’ll all continue to buy your products. Otherwise there are better options.
